plugins.name: bioflow
plugins.description: Edit, publish, and measure link-in-bio pages from Claude with BioFlow: add and reorder links and blocks in a draft, publish or schedule with a preview and confirmation, and report views, clicks, and signups.

skills.name: analyzing-page-performance
skills.description: Reports how a BioFlow link-in-bio page performs and who it captured: views, link clicks, CTR, top links, referrers, tip revenue, newsletter and lead signups, contacts, and uploaded files. Use when the user asks 'how did my page do last month', 'who signed up through my page', 'which links get the most clicks', 'where does my traffic come from', 'show my bio link analytics', or 'list my leads'. Read-only.

skills.name: editing-page-drafts
skills.description: Edits the draft of a BioFlow link-in-bio page: adds, changes, removes, or reorders links, images, products, newsletter signups, booking embeds, and other blocks, renames a page, or creates a new page. Use when the user asks to 'add a link to my YouTube channel', 'update my bio link page', 'rename my page title', 'move the newsletter block to the top', 'remove this link', 'create a new link in bio page', or edit their creator landing page. Changes the draft only; never publishes.

skills.name: publishing-pages
skills.description: Publishes or schedules a BioFlow page's draft so it goes live, after showing a preview of what changes and getting the user's confirmation. Use when the user asks to 'publish my page', 'go live', 'push my changes live', 'schedule my page to go live Monday at 9am', 'make my link in bio public', or 'update the live page'. Needs the workspace publishing setting plus a two-step confirmation.

skills.name: setup-bioflow
skills.description: Connects the BioFlow MCP server to Claude and verifies it with one read-only call: where to connect in claude.ai, Claude Desktop, Cowork, or Claude Code, what the BioFlow sign-in and consent screen asks, and how to recover when a tool is missing. Use when the user asks to 'set up BioFlow', 'connect BioFlow to Claude', 'install the BioFlow connector', 'sign in to BioFlow', 'why can't Claude see my BioFlow data', 'BioFlow tools are missing', or reports 'Tool not found' for a BioFlow tool.
